headline: LAD @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.54 at SDP 4.00, with a projected total of 8.53. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (LAD +0.42, SDP +0.47), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.89, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Walker Buehler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Samad Taylor, Mookie Betts, Freddie Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rodolfo Durán, Gavin Sheets because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
